hero.title: Minute of Silence
hero.subtitle: Automatically conducts a moment of silence daily at 9:00 AM. 10 audio presets to choose from.

about.title: What is it?
about.description: Desktop app for Windows, Linux, and macOS that automatically conducts a moment of silence at 9:00 AM daily.
about.shortlyContent: Runs in background with minimal resource usage. Starts automatically with the system. Supports NTP time synchronization.

features.title: Features
features.description: Everything needed to conduct the ceremony.

auto.name: ⏰ Automatic
auto.meta: Starts with Windows/Linux/macOS and conducts the ceremony daily at 9:00 AM

media.name: 🔇 Stops Media
media.meta: Automatically pauses music and video in all apps

signal.name: 🔔 Signal
signal.meta: Plays audio signal at the beginning and end of the ceremony

ntp.name: 💾 NTP Sync
ntp.meta: Precise time via NTP server, even if system time is off

skip.name: 📅 Skip Day
skip.meta: Option to skip the ceremony for a specific day

volume.name: 🔊 Volume Control
volume.meta: Automatic volume control during the ceremony

builder.title: Ceremony Constructor
builder.description: Build the ceremony from slots instead of picking a fixed set. The ceremony always uses the single voice you choose.

list.title: Announcement
list.subtitle: Optional
list.content: The spoken announcement of the selected voice.

list.title: Main part
list.subtitle: Required
list.content: The metronome or one minute of silence.

list.title: Closing
list.subtitle: Optional
list.content: Voice ending, bell or anthem, or nothing.

origin.title: Original Idea
origin.description: The desktop app is a development of Bohdan Hdal's idea — the author of the "Memory Minute" mobile app.
origin.authorContent: First implemented the idea of automatic moment of silence in a mobile app for iOS and Android. His interview on "Radio Culture" became the impetus for creating this desktop version.
origin.quote: "Since this is a thing for the common good, I only welcome any development of the idea"

community.title: Memory is Action
community.description: Every day at 09:00, it's not just our app that stops. People across the country take to the streets to make the memory of our heroes visible.
community.supportText: Khvylyna.pp.ua sincerely shares the values of the 'Vshanuy' civic organization and encourages supporting their actions.

download.title: Download
download.description: Free download for Windows, Linux, and macOS.

list.q: Do I need to install it?
list.a: Yes, it's a desktop app for Windows/Linux/macOS. Installs once and automatically starts with the system.
No, runs in background. Activates only for a short time at 9:00 AM.

list.q: Do notifications come before the ceremony?
list.a: Notifications are disabled by default. If you enable them in settings, a reminder will appear 5 minutes before the ceremony.
Currently the time is fixed at 9:00 AM. This matches the traditional time for conducting a moment of silence in Ukraine.
Yes, through the app interface or system tray.
